import cvxpy as cp
import numpy as np
from cvxpy.reductions.complex2real.canonicalizers import matrix_canon

# Build the problem from the bug report
X = cp.Variable((3,3), symmetric=True)
z = cp.Variable(complex=True)

objective = cp.Maximize(cp.trace(X))
constraints = [
    cp.lambda_sum_largest(X, 2) <= 5,
    X >> 0,
    X << 10 * np.eye(3),
    cp.abs(z) <= 1  # This forces Complex2Real canonicalization
]

problem = cp.Problem(objective, constraints)
result = problem.solve(solver='CLARABEL', verbose=False)

probe('mixed_real_complex_objective', result)
probe('lambda_sum_largest_value', cp.lambda_sum_largest(X, 2).value)
